title: Phase 0 spike criteria file
description: Schema of docs/phase0/criteria/S<n>.yaml and X1.yaml (and the .v<k> amendment files) after YAML parsing. X1 is the optional, non-gating overlayfs experiment. A frozen file is immutable; its identity is the (file, version, SHA-256) tuple in frozen.lock.

gates.description: The ADR the spike gates; none for X1, which never gates.

fallback.description: Fallback decision applied on FAIL for gating spikes S1 to S5 (spec FR-031); X1 has no fallback.

amends.description: Version this file amends. Required when criteria_version >= 2.

changelog.description: Pre-freeze edit notes (plan open item O2). Not used after freeze.

tables.description: Data tables read by the checks, for example S2 recoverability predictions, the S3 crash-point rule, the S4 degraded-state table.

observable.description: Checkable expected outcome; decidable without interpretation.

check.description: Name of the automated check in the spike's test script. Required unless review is true.

review.description: True only for the written recovery procedure of S2.7 (spec FR-002). The automated step checks stay (a failed step check makes S2.7 fail without review); the final outcome is set by a review record named by review_kind. Until a review record names the newest spike-run under the current criteria version, S2.7 and the S2 spike status are pending only when the automated step checks pass and every other S2 scenario passed (derived, never stored); a review of an older run does not affect this status, and a failed other scenario makes the run FAIL regardless of review.

review_kind.description: Required when review is true, forbidden otherwise: the kind of the result record that judges this scenario. A record of this kind (see result-record.schema.json) names the S2 spike-run record it reviews in reviewed_record and sets the scenario to pass or fail in review.outcome, with reviewer, date and evidence.

cases.description: Case generator name for matrix scenarios, for example mover-crash-points. Case ids are <scenario id>:<case>.

variants.description: Only with a variant generator such as mount-variants (S1.2, S1.6, S1.8): the variants the generator produces and whether each gates. The case id of a variant is <scenario id>:<variant>; the recorder writes the gating flag of the variant onto the case entry of the result record. At least one variant gates (the baseline); a variant with gating false is informational and never changes the scenario outcome. Generators without variants (for example mover-crash-points) produce only gating cases.

case.description: Variant part of the case id, for example ff or lus.

prediction.description: S2 only: reference to a key under tables that predicts recoverable and unrecoverable items at block granularity (spec FR-016).
